note: Each candidate project is mirrored in a folder under candidates/. Star counts were captured from GitHub during the survey. Candidates were found by keyword search and are unverified; inclusion here does not mean they implement the paper.

candidates.description: General long-context attention toolkit: flash attention, sliding window, block sparse attention and token routing utilities for transformer training.
Gated extension of Dilated Token Routing with capacity-aware sparse attention for long-context language models.
Official implementation of Sparse Routing Networks for conditional computation at scale; sparse token routing for long-context transformer blocks.
PyTorch implementation of Dilated Token Routing (DTR) for sparse context access in long-sequence transformers.
JAX/Flax implementation of Dilated Token Routing (DTR) sparse context access.
Reproduction scripts and notebooks for Dilated Token Routing (DTR) long-context experiments.
Placeholder for a community implementation of Dilated Token Routing (DTR).
Reading notes and summaries of the Dilated Token Routing (DTR) paper.
